scopeHint: Here you edit the description and appearance. Admins manage names, leads, members and structure.
imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

description.label: Description
description.hint: Markdown is supported. Existing HTML descriptions stay unchanged unless you edit this field.

name.label: Name
name.entraHint: If the department sync with Microsoft Entra is on, rename the department there as well. Otherwise its members lose it at their next sign-in.

head.label: Head (display)
head.hint: Shown on the department page. Rights come from the department head role with this department in the profile.

lead.label: Team lead
lead.hint: May edit the team description and reaches news for the team. The team lead role is assigned separately.

members.label: Members ({count})
members.hint: Members see the team's wiki spaces and news for the team.

adminScopeHint: As an admin you also manage the name, lead and members. Changes apply at once.
departmentsTile: Create, rename, set the head of or delete departments.
teamsTile: Create teams, set their lead and members, or delete them.
optionsFailed: The selection lists could not be loaded. Leads and members cannot be changed right now.

confirmDelete.departmentBody: {members, plural, =0 {Nobody belongs to it} one {# person loses the department} other {# people lose the department}}, {teams, plural, =0 {no team is affected} one {# team loses it} other {# teams lose it}}. Linked news, documents, quick links and courses are then visible to admins and editors only until they are re-targeted. This cannot be undone.
confirmDelete.teamBody: {members, plural, =0 {The team has no members} one {# member loses the team} other {# members lose the team}}. News for this team is then visible to admins and editors only until it is re-targeted. This cannot be undone.
